info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Distribution API
info.description: The Product Inventory Distribution API enables users to access and manage product inventory data specific to various banking channels. This API provides capabilities to retrieve detailed information about product availability, allocation, and distribution across different platforms. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial service providers that need real-time insights into their product inventory to optimize operations and decision-making. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure effective inventory management and enhance customer service by providing accurate product availability information.

get.summary: Retrieve product inventory distribution for a specific channel.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the inventory distribution details for products associated with a specific sales channel. You can use this information to assess product availability and optimize inventory management for different channels.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information about product inventory distribution for a specific channel. Ensure that the payload adheres to the defined schema to successfully query the system.

200.description: Successful retrieval of product inventory distribution data.
